claims.rationale: The cited Crossref records confirm IDS/IPS publications in 2016 (E_29_8E495DC2A98305B1), 2017 (E_29_BAD6581A8E96027C), and 2024 (E_29_CA00E63DF08A6FC1). Specifically, E_29_CA00E63DF08A6FC1 (published 2024-01-22) describes the use of IDS and IPS methods with Telegram notifications.

E_12_D8076704AE363FE2 (MITRE ATT&CK M1029) contains a section on 'Intrusion Detection Log Forwarding' that explicitly describes forwarding logs from IDS/IPS systems (listing Suricata as an example) to a remote security information system and provides a Suricata syslog example.
